_readme: Manual metadata keyed by sample id (ids are listed in manifest.json). The scanner merges these entries when generating the manifest. A sample without an entry still works but is treated as provenance=unknown / status=unverified / role=reference.

15.1.GRAPH.graph_V0.1.notes: GRAPH baseline template; embedded directly by the csproj (Link=Templates/GRAPH_V15_1.xml); no copy in the repository.

15.1.LAD.LAD_V0.1.notes: 12 networks covering contacts, coils, OR branch, latching, timers, counters, and Move; interface sections are empty (no local variables).

15.1.LAD.interface_io_contact_coil.notes: Hand-authored minimal FC: Input Start/Stop, Output Running; one network Start AND NOT Stop -> Running; all operands use Scope=LocalVariable. Validated against the V15.1 official XSD only, not compiled in TIA; verify before use.

15.1.LAD.interface_io_contact_coil_fb.notes: Hand-authored minimal FB: Input Start/Stop, Output Running, Static Mem; one network (Start OR Mem) AND NOT Stop -> Running; all four operands use Scope=LocalVariable, with an OR branch and a static member reference. Mem is only a static-member example and is not written in the network. Validated against the V15.1 official XSD only, not compiled in TIA; verify before use.
